new_packages.label: תּוֹרָה וְרוּחָנִיּוּת
new_packages.qualifies_because: Four bechina-connected concepts forming an independent thematic domain not covered by any existing package for this Torah. These concepts share the essential nature of 'Torah as pure spiritual reality, unlimited and unlimiting.' The bechina chain: Torah ↔ ruchaniyut (explicit: 'haTorah hi ruchaniyut'); ruchaniyut ↔ lo tofes makom (definitional: 'davar ruchani eino tofes makom'); Torah ↔ sekhel ruchani (parallel vessel-content nature); sekhel ruchani ↔ lo tofes makom (Torah can spread and dwell in the spiritual sekhel because neither displaces the other). All four nodes are explicitly connected by the markers 'הִיא' (is), repeated definitional axiom (x2), and the functional equivalence of spiritual vessel and spiritual content.
new_packages.independence_argument: The domain of Torah-as-ruchaniyut is specific to Torah #110's argument and does not duplicate any existing package. While 'Torah' and 'ruchaniyut' appear in other Torahs, Torah #110 establishes a unique local configuration: ruchaniyut is THE essential definition of Torah (not merely a property), lo tofes makom is ruchaniyut's definitional identity, and sekhel ruchani is the human vessel that shares this nature. This specific triangulation — Torah = spirituality = no-space = compatible with spiritual intellect — is the teaching's unique conceptual contribution. The package is built around the pedagogical insight that Torah's unlimited retention is possible BECAUSE Torah is spiritual and spiritual things share space without displacing each other.

new_packages.label: מַמָּשׁוּת וְגַשְׁמִיּוּת
new_packages.qualifies_because: Three bechina-connected concepts forming an independent thematic domain — the evil/deficiency mirror of Package 110-A. These concepts share the essential nature of 'the materialization of Torah, making it subject to physical limits.' The bechina chain: mamashut ↔ gashmiyut (synonymic coupling repeated twice in lines 4 and 5 — the Rebbe treats them as interchangeable, establishing shared essential nature); mamashut ↔ yamush (etymological bechina: 'yamush — mileshon mamashut' — the word yamush IS from the root of mamashut). Three nodes, three bechina markers, one unified thematic domain: Torah made physical. While 3 nodes is the minimum threshold for a new package, this cluster qualifies strongly because: (a) all three bechina connections are explicit with named markers; (b) the cluster has clear independence from Package 110-A (opposite polarity, opposite essential nature); (c) the cluster has a named dominant concept (mamashut) with the highest degree (2 connections).
new_packages.independence_argument: The domain of mamashut/gashmiyut is the structurally independent evil mirror of the ruchaniyut domain. It is not a sub-theme of Package 110-A but its exact opposite pole. The teaching's entire practical instruction ('hizaher shelo tihyeh mamashut...') is directed at preventing the Package 110-B state. The etymological move ('yamush mileshon mamashut') is the Rebbe's hermeneutic contribution — reinterpreting a biblical verse's key word through the lens of this teaching's central evil concept. This interpretive move is unique to Torah #110 and makes yamush a local bechina node that belongs only in this Torah's Package 110-B.

observations:
Torah #110 is structurally one of the simplest Torahs in LM1: 6 lines, one binary opposition, 7 nodes total, 9 proposed bechina edges, 4 eitza-excluded nodes. Its simplicity is its elegance — the teaching makes a single, deep point:

Torah's essential nature is spiritual (ruchaniyut). A spiritual thing takes no space. Therefore, a person with a spiritual intellect can hold ALL of Torah and forget NOTHING. The danger is the person who 'makes Torah into mamashut' — materializes it — whereupon it becomes subject to physical limits: you can hold only so much, and adding more pushes out what was there. This is the origin of forgetting.

The verse 'Lo yamush sefer haTorah hazeh mipicha' is reinterpreted: 'yamush' = 'mileshon mamashut' — the verse warns not against Torah departing the mouth in the simple sense, but against Torah becoming mamashut (materialized) through the mouth.

Since the dataset contains ZERO edges for Torah #110, BOTH packages are entirely new — first-time extractions from the source text. The teaching requires 7 new nodes and 9 new bechina edges to be added to the dataset.

The good/evil mirror is the cleanest possible binary:
  - תּוֹרָה ↔ (no evil mirror; Torah itself is always good — it is the TREATMENT of Torah that creates the binary)
  - רוּחָנִיּוּת ↔ גַּשְׁמִיּוּת
  - שֵׂכֶל רוּחָנִי ↔ (implicit: sekhel she-eino ruchani — the non-spiritual intellect that materializes)
  - לֹא תּוֹפֵס מָקוֹם ↔ שִׁעוּר וְקִצְבָּה (this mirror is present but shiyur ve-kitzba is eitza from mamashut, not its bechina)
  - מַמָּשׁוּת ↔ רוּחָנִיּוּת (direct mirror)
  - יָמוּשׁ ↔ יִשְׁכֹּן בְּשִׂכְלוֹ (Torah dwelling in the sekhel, vs. yamush = departing/materializing)

The two eitza flows of the teaching:
  Package 110-A (ruchaniyut) → eitza → קִיּוּם הַלִּמּוּד (learning is sustained, no forgetting)
  Package 110-B (mamashut) → eitza → שִׁכְחָה (forgetting comes)

The practical instruction (eitza) connecting the packages: 'hizaher shelo tihyeh mamashut ve-gashmiyut be-divrei haTorah mipicha' — be careful that Torah should not become physical through your mouth. This is the bridge: moving away from Package 110-B toward Package 110-A.
